Brand

The logo, the colours, the type, the photography, the house style. From the organisation's guidelines if supplied (then they live in 06 and this folder points at them), otherwise from a public brand centre or press kit, the site's own CSS (the real hex values and font names), and screenshots of the site for reference. Note the licence of every typeface.

Name every file with its date and where it came from, for example 2026-09-17_careers-page_apprenticeships.pdf, and log it in Springpod_LEARN_Organisation_Knowledge_Base_V1.docx.
